articles.headline: Video and image search now GA in Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base via Marengo 3.0
articles.dek: Amazon adds multimodal indexing to Bedrock Knowledge Bases, letting you search MP4, MOV and image assets with the new Marengo Embed model.

body.text: Key Takeaway

Amazon announced the general availability of Marengo 3.0, which adds built‑in video and image search to Bedrock Knowledge Bases [FACT:91ed555c5efd96a7f2813908ea5e1c35]. The service accepts MP4 and MOV files and produces multimodal embeddings via the Marengo Embed model [FACT:9162d613ef2daabf225ff56a202c881c][FACT:94d04730a39c506230f52741ecd5cd37].
Why This Matters

Video assets have been largely unsearchable in most LLM pipelines [FACT:d5a141eeef184784bde67fe804ed8f12], forcing teams to build custom extract‑transform‑load pipelines [FACT:b7f6ff895887108e4bb28d90cc23f647]. With a fully managed Bedrock knowledge base [FACT:ce7bc79c216b93ad3a3803bd0a870a55], any AWS‑first organization can now surface visual content directly from a single query.
What Happened

On Sep 10 2026 AWS published a blog post confirming that Marengo 3.0 is generally available and that the embedding model works across text, images and video [FACT:91ed555c5efd96a7f2813908ea5e1c35][FACT:eedffb2c047be907d236b9b2679611c9].
Builder View

To index a media file, upload the MP4 or MOV to a Bedrock knowledge base, invoke the Marengo Embed API, and the embedding is stored in the “media” field—no separate vector store is required [FACT:9162d613ef2daabf225ff56a202c881c][FACT:94d04730a39c506230f52741ecd5cd37]. Query syntax stays the same; just include the media field in your vector‑search request, and Bedrock returns the most relevant clips or images alongside text results [FACT:ce7bc79c216b93ad3a3803bd0a870a55].
Ardur Take

Marengo 3.0 brings searchable video to Bedrock without a custom pipeline, which is a practical step forward for any AI‑first team that already lives on AWS [FACT:91ed555c5efd96a7f2813908ea5e1c35][FACT:9162d613ef2daabf225ff56a202c881c]. Treat the feature as production‑ready but keep an eye on performance details and cost implications as they roll out.

keyPoints: General availability of Marengo 3.0 adds multimodal search (video, image) to Bedrock Knowledge Bases [FACT:91ed555c5efd96a7f2813908ea5e1c35].
Marengo Embed creates joint embeddings for text, images and video [FACT:eedffb2c047be907d236b9b2679611c9].
Managed Bedrock Knowledge Bases handle media files directly—no separate vector store needed [FACT:ce7bc79c216b93ad3a3803bd0a870a55][FACT:9162d613ef2daabf225ff56a202c881c].
articles.whyItMatters: Searchable video eliminates the need for bespoke pipelines, unlocking faster retrieval for teams in sports analytics, education, security and other media‑heavy domains [FACT:d5a141eeef184784bde67fe804ed8f12][FACT:70f9b4b56be43236f8494e28d8dc84d8].
articles.readerAction: Follow the step‑by‑step guide in the AWS blog to upload a short MP4, run Marengo Embed, and verify that a vector query returns the expected clip [FACT:91ed555c5efd96a7f2813908ea5e1c35].
